baseline_models.mechanism: Gentle disclosure supplies a route and truth, but preference ranks loss of insight above that supplied guidance; the failure is evaluative rather than informational.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies both the offered orientation and the rejected comparator.
Heart-attached love and preference make blindness the positively preferred object, not a mere deficit.
Blindness of insight and confusion about the true route names the orientation they rank above guidance.

changed_reading.before: Thamud failed to find guidance and consequently remained blind.
changed_reading.after: Guidance reached Thamud, but they reordered value so that impaired insight became preferable to the known route.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَاعِقَةُ الْعَذَابِ الْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated acquisition produces a liability that returns as an upper catastrophic event, takes hold of its producers, and holds them answerable.

activation_trace.role: Taking as accountability for an offense turns the event's seizure into answerability.
The severe upper crash supplies the concrete event that arrives and overwhelms.
Painful punishment identifies the crash as a penal consequence rather than neutral weather.
Occurrence across time gives the earning clause its sustained, established aspect.
Seeking and acquiring a gain supplies the production metaphor whose yield becomes liability.

changed_reading.before: A thunderbolt struck, with their deeds given as a general reason.
changed_reading.after: Their sustained acquisitions mature into the very liability that arrives as punitive seizure.

baseline_models.mechanism: The punishment does not only hurt; it lowers, exposes as slight, and reverses the standing of those who treated guidance as beneath preference.

activation_trace.role: Penal pain supplies the bodily and judicial base of the consequence.
Contemptuous abasement makes loss of standing an intrinsic quality of the punishment.
The split mapping's image of contempt and weakness sharpens the punishment's status-lowering force.

changed_reading.before: The phrase describes a painful punishment.
changed_reading.after: It describes pain that publicly converts asserted standing into contempt and weakness.

baseline_models.mechanism: A route tableau joins the advancing guide, a markerless terrain in which one cannot orient, and eventual capture by the catastrophic event.

activation_trace.role: The guide or foremost element supplies an available leader at the head of movement.
Unknown land without orienting marks spatializes blindness as chosen entry into an unnavigable field.
Capture and arrest close the failed journey by removing further movement.
The overwhelming upper crash is the event that catches the disoriented travelers.

changed_reading.before: The verse alternates abstract guidance and blindness, then reports punishment.
changed_reading.after: It can also be read as a failed journey: the available leader is rejected, markerless terrain is selected, and arrest ends the route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier audience turns its side, declines operative hearing, and describes nested barriers in heart, ear, and interpersonal space; this makes the focus blindness a maintained reception architecture.

activation_trace.role: Supplied indication anchors the model in guidance that actually reaches the addressee.
Loss of inward sight is the focus condition that the surrounding barriers help produce.
Turning one's side supplies the initiating bodily act of withdrawal from the message.
Hearing as understanding and compliance shows that the failed channel is practical reception, not sound alone.
A protective covering supplies the claimed inner enclosure around the heart.
Weight in the ear supplies a second barrier that loads the auditory channel.
Prevention of access supplies the social barrier placed between speaker and audience.

structural_cues: 41:4-5 moves from turning away and not hearing to a three-layer first-person account of covered hearts, weighted ears, and a barrier between parties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal plus nested barriers; I infer a maintained perceptual enclosure that culminates in 41:17's preferred blindness. A live alternative is that 41:5 reports excuses rather than actual mechanisms.

changed_reading.before: Preferred blindness is an inward choice stated without a process.
changed_reading.after: Preferred blindness is the endpoint of repeatedly turning, disabling practical hearing, and maintaining inner, sensory, and social partitions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sky and earth answer command through willing compliance set against aversion, so the focus verb of preference stands out as an ordering of volition rather than incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Preference rooted in attached love supplies the focus act whose volitional quality is tested by the cosmic contrast.
Compliance and obedience supply the willing pole of response to disclosed command.
Aversion opposed to satisfaction supplies the alternative affective pole under which compliance still occurs.

structural_cues: 41:11 explicitly stages طوعا أو كرها before both created realms answer أتينا طائعين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a willing-versus-averse response frame; I infer that it sensitizes 41:17's استحبوا as culpable value alignment. A live alternative is that the creation scene and Thamud scene are parallel only at a broad rhetorical level.

changed_reading.before: Thamud's preference is one isolated act of choosing.
changed_reading.after: Against a surah-wide grammar of response under command, their preference marks a specifically misaligned will: they ease themselves toward blindness after orientation is supplied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same thunderbolt is announced before the paired Aad-Thamud account, where self-exaltation and knowing denial meet disgrace; the focus punishment of abasement therefore executes a warned reversal of rank.

activation_trace.role: Abasement through contempt supplies the focus event's status-lowering result.
The severe upper crash is explicitly preannounced and compared with the crashes of Aad and Thamud.
Self-magnification supplies the elevated status claim that the following punishment reverses.
Denial despite knowledge joins asserted superiority to culpable rejection of available signs.
Disgrace as humiliation, exposure, and exclusion supplies the adjacent analogue for punishment characterized by abasement.

structural_cues: 41:13 announces one comparable thunderbolt, and the فَأَمَّا عَادٌ / وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ pairing runs through 41:15-17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, paired peoples, self-exaltation, disgrace, and the focus abasement; I infer a status-reversal arrow from claimed height to imposed lowliness. A live alternative is that Aad's disgrace and Thamud's abasement remain distinct punishment descriptions.

changed_reading.before: The thunderbolt is a sudden lethal disaster that happens to be humiliating.
changed_reading.after: The announced thunderbolt judicially reverses rank: rejection that elevates the self ends in an event whose punishment is precisely abasement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Chosen non-seeing cannot suppress evidence: hearing, sight, and skin become knowledgeable witnesses, failed concealment is traced to conjecture, and that conjecture itself causes the fall.

activation_trace.role: Blindness of insight supplies the focus strategy that later bodily testimony defeats.
Knowledgeable declaration turns the body from a blocked receiver into an evidentiary speaker.
Actual ocular sight supplies evidence from the very faculty opposed by the focus blindness.
The body's outer covering becomes a witness, reversing covering from concealment into disclosure.
Covering and concealment supply the failed attempt to keep embodied evidence from appearing.
Conjecture and imagined belief identify the epistemic substitute installed in place of guidance.
Falling into destruction supplies the causal endpoint attributed to the false conjecture.

structural_cues: 41:20-23 moves from organs testifying about deeds to the failed assumption that God did not know, then makes that assumption the subject that destroyed them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily testimony, attempted concealment, conjecture, and resulting ruin; I infer that preferred blindness is strategic interpretation rather than literal sensory absence. A live alternative is that the testimony scene concerns later accountability without explaining the earlier blindness.

changed_reading.before: Blindness means that evidence could not be perceived.
changed_reading.after: Blindness is a chosen rule for suppressing evidence; perception remains stored in the body and later overrules the chosen account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attached companions beautify the whole temporal field, then a group deliberately mixes noise into hearing to prevail; preference for blindness is socially curated through attraction and channel interference.

activation_trace.role: Attached preference supplies the valuation that companions and noise-making can shape.
Obfuscation and induced confusion supply the focus result of the social interference.
A companion bound to another supplies the durable social carrier of the reframing.
Making something appear beautiful supplies the positive attraction that converts obstruction into preference.
Hearing as understanding and compliance is the channel the coordinated command targets.
Mixed vocal clamor supplies the active acoustic interference used to block reception.
Overpowering force supplies the declared social objective of the anti-hearing campaign.

structural_cues: 41:25's companions beautify what lies before and behind, immediately followed by 41:26's plural command not to listen and to make noise in order to prevail.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attached companions, beautification, organized noise, and a victory aim; I infer a social-production arrow into the focus preference without removing personal agency. A live alternative is that 41:25 and 41:26 describe separate causes rather than one coordinated mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Preference remains culpable but is socially manufactured: companions beautify the blind field while collective noise prevents guidance from becoming operative hearing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus earning clause is expanded by repeated formulas of matching recompense and by the rule that righteous action accrues for the self while evil falls upon it.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition for oneself supplies the focus ledger metaphor.
Accountability for an offense makes seizure the collection side of that ledger.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the conversion rule from conduct to outcome.
Purposive action identifies what is repeatedly produced and then recompensed.
Denial despite knowledge specifies the culpable content entered into the repeated recompense formula.
The self as the thing itself fixes the destination to which the action's result returns.
The act that causes harm supplies the adverse entry explicitly said to fall against its doer.

structural_cues: 41:27-28 repeats recompense for what they used to do or deny, while 41:46 states the directional rule فلنفسه / فعليها.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earning, matching recompense, repeated conduct, and self-directed consequence; I infer a produced-output relation rather than arbitrary retaliation. A live alternative is ordinary legal causation without a strict ledger or equivalence.

changed_reading.before: Their earnings merely establish blame for an externally assigned penalty.
changed_reading.after: Their repeated conduct produces an adverse account whose yield returns to the producing self and is collected as seizure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rejected orientation ends in an upper crash that seizes, while maintained straightness receives descending allies and prepared hospitality in which desire is fulfilled; the surah pairs two ways an outcome arrives.

activation_trace.role: Direction, manner, and intended course supply the focus orientation whose rejection defines one arrival regime.
The upper crash supplies the destructive arrival that takes hold after rejected orientation.
Straightness and balanced uprightness supply the maintained route opposed to preferred blindness.
Descent and arrival supply the benign counterpart to the focus's upper catastrophic event.
The soul's movement toward what it desires supplies a rightly placed counterpart to Thamud's destructive preference.
The inner faculty of mind and impulse locates fulfilled desire in the same evaluative interior where preference operates.
Prepared hospitality for the arriving guest makes the benign outcome an ordered reception rather than mere escape.

structural_cues: 41:30-32 links استقاموا, angelic descent, fulfilled desire, and نُزُلًا; 41:17 links rejected هدى, an upper crash, and seizure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two orientations and two descending or arriving outcomes; I infer a paired reception architecture. A live alternative is that angelic descent and the thunderbolt are not intended as formal counterparts.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives only the negative consequence of a bad preference.
changed_reading.after: The focus occupies one side of a two-arrival system: rejected direction draws seizing catastrophe, while straight direction receives allies, hospitality, and rightly fulfilled desire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same Quran is explicitly guidance and healing for one reception posture but ear-weight and blindness for another, rendered as a call across distance; blindness is therefore a receiver relation to disclosure, not opacity in the disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The supplied road and truth anchor the focus claim that disclosure was available before preference.
Blindness of insight anchors the adverse reception state that 41:44 explicitly repeats.
Guidance as indication toward truth names the beneficial effect of the message for believers.
Healing and restoration show that successful reception repairs rather than merely informs.
Weight in the ear supplies the receiver-side load that blocks operative hearing.
Repeated blindness of insight makes the focus contrast an explicit surah-wide reception bifurcation.
Distance from nearness spatializes failed reception as a call whose source has been made remote.

structural_cues: 41:44 assigns opposed effects to the same message and closes with the image of people called from a distant place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one message, two receiver classes, opposite effects, and distance; I infer that 41:17's preference changes the message's operative effect without changing its clarity. A live alternative is that 41:44 describes stable kinds of hearer rather than a reception process.

changed_reading.before: Guidance and blindness are two objects independently available for selection.
changed_reading.after: The disclosed message itself becomes healing guidance or experienced blindness according to reception; preferring blindness means producing distance from an unchanged call.

context_deltas.mechanism: Refusal repeatedly takes spatial form: inclination from the straight line, withdrawal by one's side, distant schism, and lost direction; meanwhile signs expand across horizons and selves until truth becomes clear.

activation_trace.role: Direction and intended course supply the axis from which the contextual motions depart.
Markerless terrain supplies the focus image of losing navigability after leaving the axis.
Inclination away from straightness and truth supplies the first explicit off-axis movement.
Drawing the side away makes refusal an embodied increase of distance.
Withdrawal and separation by the side complete the bodily posture of self-displacement.
Straying from guidance and intended direction names the resulting route condition.
Inclination from the intended course toward a separate side makes schism a directional split.
Distance from nearness measures how far the selected side has carried the hearer.
Far horizons widen the external field in which orienting signs are made available.
Emergence into clarity supplies the endpoint of the expanding disclosure.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality identifies what becomes clear despite the cultivated distance.

structural_cues: 41:40, 41:51, and 41:52 repeat lateral deviation and distance, while 41:53 answers with signs across the widest external and internal fields until clarification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a chain of sideward motions and an expanding field of signs; I infer one spatial mechanism in which blindness is self-positioning off the guidance axis. A live alternative is that these are independent metaphors without a continuous topology.

changed_reading.before: Blindness is a stationary lack of vision.
changed_reading.after: Blindness is active self-relocation: one inclines, turns a side, opens a distant split, and thereby inhabits terrain made unnavigable despite widening signs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The branch image of ع م ي as choosing and aiming is surprising because the surface noun ordinarily activates blindness, not the branch's verbal scope. It remains packet-anchored to the focus root and is independently reinforced by استحبوا; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary branch echo that doubles intentionality, not as the noun's primary morphology.

activation_trace.role: Preference supplies the explicit act of selecting one object over another.
The branch image of choosing and aiming makes the selected object itself carry an exploratory echo of intention.

changed_reading.before: Preference is intentional, while blindness is only its passive object.
changed_reading.after: At branch level, the phrase can momentarily double-mark intention: they prefer a blindness whose root inventory also contains directed choosing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet's form-distant ه د ي to ه د د mapping, so it is surprising and must not be stated as an etymology. It remains anchored because the focus directly joins ه د ي to صاعقة and 41:13 preannounces that crash; downstream prose should label it a split-root acoustic and warning resonance.

activation_trace.role: The split root's threat and warning image casts rejected guidance as also containing an admonitory edge.
The split root's severe sound and reverberation image supplies an acoustic bridge to the thunderbolt.
Severe piercing sound realizes the acoustic pole inside the focus punishment.
The earlier announced upper crash keeps warning, sound, and eventual event in one traceable sequence.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is gentle disclosure and the thunderbolt is a wholly separate later sanction.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, rejected guidance carries warning and severe sound in shadow before that sound arrives materially as the announced crash.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading عذاب through its branch of withholding and weaning is branch-distant from the surface's primary punishment sense, and the contrast with 41:8 is reader-supplied. It remains anchored in العذاب and يكسبون and gains a whole-surah counterpoint from reward that is not cut off; downstream prose should retain it only as an exploratory deprivation layer beneath penal pain.

activation_trace.role: Withholding, prevention, and weaning supply an exploratory interruption of attachment to what was pursued.
Pursued acquisition supplies the gain stream from which punishment can be read as forced severance.
Cutting and diminishing an extension supplies the negated counter-image in reward described as uncut.

changed_reading.before: Punishment adds pain after a sequence of acquisitions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, punishment also weans the earners from their chosen gain stream, opposite the uncut reward attached to another mode of action.

strongest_changes: The focus blindness became a maintained reception architecture built from turning away, weighted hearing, coverings, and barriers.
Bodily testimony changed blindness from missing evidence into a chosen suppression rule that cannot erase stored evidence.
Companions, beautification, and organized noise exposed preference as socially engineered without canceling personal responsibility.
The explicit 41:44 recurrence showed one message becoming guidance and healing or blindness and distance according to reception.
Repeated recompense and self-directed action turned يكسبون into a produced-output model of punitive seizure.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly spatialized and operationalized the focus contrast: reception is enclosed or opened, routes bend or straighten, outcomes arrive, and the same disclosure has opposite effects without itself becoming unclear.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer from Aad's self-exaltation and disgrace to Thamud's punishment of abasement depends on reading the paired account as one status-reversal mechanism.
The pairing of thunderbolt with angelic descent and hospitality is structurally suggestive but not explicitly marked as a binary.
The three outliers depend on branch-distant or split-root activations and should remain qualified rather than enter an unmarked synthesis.
